text:
Done. ThisBuild / tlFatalWarnings := true in build.sbt; full suite 330 green with zero warnings.

This bead paid for itself immediately. Turning -Werror on exposed TWO non-exhaustive matches over SlurmState that P8.A2 had introduced and that a green 328-test suite did not catch:
  - cli/SlurmParsers.scala:372 (SacctParsable2.outcome) — no mapping for BootFail, Deadline, Suspended
  - cli/SlurmParsers.scala:622 (SlurmTiming.classifyStart) — same three missing

Both matches were already written exhaustively with NO catch-all, which is exactly why the omission was dangerous rather than benign: adding an enum case turned them into runtime MatchErrors on any site reporting BOOT_FAIL or DEADLINE — the very states A2 existed to handle. A2 shipped that latent crash and the tests were green. This is the strongest available argument for the epic's ordering claim that Phase B belongs BEFORE Phase D, not after it.

Fixes: BootFail => WorkloadOutcome.NodeFailure, Deadline => TimeLimitExceeded, Suspended => None. For start classification, BootFail and Deadline yield JobStart.Reported rather than Actual, because a DEADLINE commonly fires while the job is still PENDING and BOOT_FAIL means the node never came up — neither may be claimed as an actual start. Suspended is Actual: it ran, then was suspended. Regression tests added; outcome and classifyStart widened from private to private[cli] so they can be tested directly.

Also fixed a deprecated `x: _*` vararg splice introduced by A2's codec change.

CORRECTION TO THIS BEAD'S OWN FRAMING: I filed it claiming two plan documents "assert -Werror is in CI" and must be corrected. Having read them, that was overstated. docs/plans/2026-07-23-site-layer.md:53 and :257 and docs/plans/2026-07-26-evidence-coherence-representation.md:38 all state it as a COMMITMENT or acceptance criterion, not as an accomplished fact. They were unmet plans, not false claims. Nothing needed correcting; B1 simply makes them true. No documentation was edited.
